title: Account Access
text:
## Reset or unlock

1. Go to the identity portal
2. Choose 'Reset password' or 'Unlock account'
3. Verify via MFA
4. Sign in again

Locked out of MFA? Raise a ticket tagged 'MFA-recovery'.
